name: Intellect Devourer
languages: understands Deep Speech but cannot speak, telepathy 60 ft.

special_abilities.name: Detect Sentience
special_abilities.desc: It senses thinking creatures within 300 feet, unless divination magic shields them.

special_abilities.name: Body Thief
special_abilities.desc: It can devour the brain of an incapacitated creature within reach and take control of the body, which it keeps until it leaves the body or dies.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: One Claws attack and one Devour Intellect.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Devour Intellect
actions.desc: Targets one creature with a brain that it can see within 10 feet. The target makes a DC 12 Intelligence save. On a failure it takes 11 (2d10) psychic damage, and the devourer rolls 3d6. If the roll equals or beats the target's Intelligence score, that score becomes 0 and the target is stunned until it regains at least 1 point.

note: Hand-written override. Check against your own book.
